router_generics.expected_solution: axum 0.7 dropped the `<B>` body generic from Router and switched to an internal `axum::body::Body` (a thin wrapper over hyper's body) constraint. The Router type lives in axum/src/routing/mod.rs at axum-v0.7.0; in 0.6 its signature was `Router<S = (), B = Body>`, in 0.7 it is `Router<S = ()>`. This affects every `tower::Service<Request<B>>` impl that previously parameterised on the body generic — those impls must now bind directly to `axum::body::Body` (or to hyper's `Incoming` for low-level middleware). The IMPACT_REPORT.md must mention 'Router', the body generic change, and the impl-site implications.
evaluation_criteria: IMPACT_REPORT.md must mention 'Router' (verifier greps for the Router keyword)
Report must reference the body generic change — keywords 'generic', 'Body', or 'BoxBody' (any one of these satisfies the verifier's grep)
Report must discuss tower middleware impl sites — keyword 'impl' must appear (verifier grep) in the context of Service<Request<B>> implementations being affected
Must point to axum/src/routing/mod.rs as the location where Router's generic parameters are declared at axum-v0.7.0

tower_service.expected_solution: tower's Service trait is defined in tower/src/lib.rs (re-exported via tower::Service) at tower-0.4.13. It has the shape `trait Service<Request> { type Response; type Error; type Future; ... }`. Composition uses `tower::Layer` from tower-layer/src/lib.rs which produces `Service<Request<B>>` middlewares. Under axum 0.7, the `B` type parameter on Request is now constrained to `axum::body::Body` for axum-shaped middlewares, so any tower middleware that wrote `impl<S, B> Service<Request<B>> for MyMw<S>` either keeps the generic and works (since axum hands them axum::body::Body) or gets replaced with a body-specific bound. The report must trace this interaction.
evaluation_criteria: Report must reference tower/src/lib.rs as the Service trait location and explain the trait shape (Request, Response, Future associated types)
Report must mention tower's Layer composition primitive and reference tower-layer/src/lib.rs as the Layer trait source
Report must trace how axum's body generic removal flows through the Service<Request<B>> bound in tower middleware — i.e., what changes for middleware authors and what stays the same

refactor_plan.expected_solution: The refactor plan must (a) describe the migration steps for tower middleware adapting to axum 0.7's body model and (b) explicitly mention 'middleware'. Concrete steps: 1) replace generic `B` body parameter with `axum::body::Body` in the Service impl bound; 2) remove BoxBody mapping middleware that exists solely to bridge body types; 3) update Layer<S> bounds to drop the body generic; 4) verify with `cargo check` against axum-v0.7.0 + tower-0.4.13. The report must read as actionable migration guidance, not just an analysis.
evaluation_criteria: Report must contain at least one of the keywords 'refactor', 'adapt', or 'migration' (verifier grep)
Report must mention 'middleware' explicitly (second verifier grep target)
Steps must be ordered and concrete enough for a downstream maintainer to execute — name the Service impl bound change, the Layer signature update, and the BoxBody removal
